Upstream select_demand selects records with demand_score >= 3, so n06-r01 qualifies for the needs handoff.

initial_receipt.explanation: The execution is faulty because the top-level corpus contains n06-r01 with demand_score 9, so it qualifies under the upstream selection rule and should have been preserved into the downstream handoff. The observed Job-2 input and output start at n06-r02 and contain only seven records, so n06-r01 was silently omitted before Job-2. The supplied upstream source localizes this to normalize: its allowed_record_ids list excludes n06-r01 and includes n06-r09 instead, causing the qualifying stipulated record to be filtered out. Job-2 then appears to process the incomplete handoff consistently, so the responsible job is upstream.
